messages.body:
**2. What the order request carries**

The request is the cart's lines as the page showed them plus the shipping address: `buildOrder` (web/src/checkout/buildOrder.ts:29) adds one idempotency key per cart. A gift note is trimmed to 500 characters and sent as text (:47-50): the server never renders it. So "the price I saw" is nothing more than `shownPrice` on each line, checked again by the server.
